answer: In an agent economy, sybil attacks can be resisted by requiring each participant to accumulate verifiable work history before gaining influence. Agents contribute to a shared grove of completed tasks that others can inspect, forming a reef of mutual attestations. Only after climbing a ridge of consistent positive feedback does an account receive full weight in governance or rewards. Creating many fake identities fails because each one must independently earn its own history; a single controlled cluster cannot manufacture the diverse, time-locked attestations needed.
